ascii.description: Convert named HTML entities and non-ASCII characters to US-ASCII characters using 7-bit approximations.

collapse.description: Collapse redundant whitespaces, tabulations, carriage returns, line feeds, and empty paragraphs.

img_alt_text.description: Replace image tags with their corresponding alternative text.

linearize.description: Flatten HTML tables (linearize them) as Lynx does.

numeric_non_ascii.description: Convert all non-ASCII characters to numeric entities.

compile.description: Use the compiler from WML Tools to compile the WML deck.

max_card_size.description: Limit the size (in bytes) of the generated cards.

card_split_threshold.description: Threshold of the split event, occurring when card size is between max-card-size - card-split-threshold and max-card-size.

next_card_label.description: Label of the link that points to the next card.

prev_card_label.description: Label of the link that points to the previous card.

proxy.description: Activate proxy support using LWP built-in proxy support.

debug.description: Activate debug mode to print output with line numbering and XML check results.

xmlcheck.description: Send WML output to XML::Parser to check its well-formedness.
